releases.notes:
Update reliability, and a fix for an appliance that could stop updating itself.

- The pre-update safety backup now covers only the add-ons being changed. It used to be a full backup, which swept up staged installers — so backups grew to gigabytes and eventually filled the disk, at which point the appliance refused its own updates. Spent installers are now removed automatically, and one previous backup is kept so the last update can still be undone.
- The front door waits for the appliance's manager service before starting. Previously, on an unlucky boot after an update, it could fall back to plain HTTP and stay there — which also made a healthy update look like it had failed.
- Settings > Updates can now be set to apply updates automatically: weekly, monthly or annually, or left on manual approval. Release notes are shown before anything is installed.
- The appliance now reports when a system component is running a version this release never validated, instead of quietly calling it current.
